what: MSI-H / dMMR stands for microsatellite instability-high or mismatch-repair deficient.
The CIViC summary in this snapshot is for MLH1, a tumor suppressor gene involved in DNA mismatch repair. Germline mutations in this gene are known to cause Lynch syndrome.
intro.test_report: If a test report mentions MSI-H or dMMR, it is recording a finding about microsatellite instability-high or mismatch-repair deficient status. This page lists public FDA companion diagnostics that look for MSI-H / dMMR, and the therapies and trials in this snapshot that use MSI-H / dMMR as a selection criterion. That mention is not a diagnosis or a treatment decision on its own.

lines.text: Dostarlimab (Jemperli) is listed on an FDA label in this snapshot.
